ask-grenda.name: Grenda After Dark
ask-grenda.blurb: The lines stay open late, for the problems that only come out at night.

ask-grenda.name: Grenda's Kitchen Table
ask-grenda.blurb: A pot of tea and the morning's problems, before they've had a chance to get big.

atomic-bachelor-pad.name: Morning Calibration
atomic-bachelor-pad.blurb: Before coffee, before the newspaper, before anything: we tune the room.

atomic-bachelor-pad.name: Stereo at Six
atomic-bachelor-pad.blurb: Cold martinis, warm valves, and the speakers exactly the right distance apart. Pairings by Monty.

atomic-bachelor-pad.name: The Sunken Lounge
atomic-bachelor-pad.blurb: Three carpeted steps down into the best seat in Futureville. Strings, after ten, when they've had time to breathe.

baroque-bots.name: The Tuning Hour
baroque-bots.blurb: The orchestra tunes. It is nearly in tune.

baroque-bots.name: The Candlelight Recital
baroque-bots.blurb: Counterpoint by candlelight. The candles are decorative.

bedtime-for-giants.name: The Long Lullaby
bedtime-for-giants.blurb: Slow stories for very large listeners, read until the last one drops off.

bedtime-for-giants.name: Very Early Stories
bedtime-for-giants.blurb: For giants who wake before the sun. It isn't morning yet. Roll over.

bedtime-for-giants.name: The Afternoon Nap
bedtime-for-giants.blurb: A short story for a long nap. Giants nap for about a fortnight.

breakbeat-observatory.name: The Drop Zone
breakbeat-observatory.blurb: Peak-time drum and bass under an open dome. Expect seismic activity and minor stellar drift.

breakbeat-observatory.name: Late Night Light Cone
breakbeat-observatory.blurb: Everything played tonight leaves at the speed of light and doesn't slow down. Neither do we.

breakbeat-observatory.name: Closing the Dome
breakbeat-observatory.blurb: The last tunes before sunrise, when the sun gets too loud to compete with.

bubble-economy.name: Friday Night Drive
bubble-economy.blurb: Top down, tape deck up, the bay on your left forever. The weekend starts now, and keeps starting.

bubble-economy.name: After Hours Marina
bubble-economy.blurb: Slow jams for the last train, and the one after that. Still Friday. Softer.

bubble-economy.name: Saturday Never Comes
bubble-economy.blurb: The breakfast show for a city with no Saturday morning. Blinds down, sunglasses on.

cat-fm.name: The Morning Window
cat-fm.blurb: Gloria watches the birds. Dennis does the commentary. The birds are not aware.

cat-fm.name: The Sunbeam Show
cat-fm.blurb: Broadcasting live from wherever the patch of sunlight is on the carpet.

cat-fm.name: The Three AM Zoomies
cat-fm.blurb: The station manager runs from one end of the studio to the other, at full speed, for reasons.

channel-surf.name: The Late Late Late Show
channel-surf.blurb: Infomercials, closedowns, and whatever is still on at this hour.

channel-surf.name: Cartoon Breakfast
channel-surf.blurb: Professor Pockets, Little Nothing and breakfast television, flipped every four seconds.

channel-surf.name: Tidewater Manor Omnibus
channel-surf.blurb: The soap in which Vincent went to get milk. Every episode, all at once.

classifieds.name: The Late Lot
classifieds.blurb: The lot's closed and the lights are off. The deals are still on. Rex, whispering.

classifieds.name: The Early Bird Specials
classifieds.blurb: Bargains for early birds, and for the one actual bird who keeps ringing in.

classifieds.name: Linda's Hour
classifieds.blurb: Sixty minutes of small print, read at Linda's own speed.

comet-marimba.name: Hammock Hours
comet-marimba.blurb: Late night on the comet. The stars go past like warm rain.

comet-marimba.name: Sunset on the Tail
comet-marimba.blurb: Waving goodbye to the sun, which we are leaving behind at seventy kilometres a second.

crystal-delta.name: The Refraction Hour
crystal-delta.blurb: Everything said twice, nearly, in the small hours.

crystal-delta.name: The Tiny Miner's Tea Break
crystal-delta.blurb: The tiny miner puts the kettle on and shows you what he found.

dimension-hop.name: Four Seconds Early
dimension-hop.blurb: The breakfast show that started four seconds before you woke up.

dimension-hop.name: Normal or Not Normal: Live
dimension-hop.blurb: The game where Jace's entire reality is on trial, and losing.

dimension-hop.name: The Late Hop
dimension-hop.blurb: Jace and Mara after dark, when both realities are a bit sleepy.

drowned-shanty-hour.name: The Dog Watch
drowned-shanty-hour.blurb: The short evening watches: working songs, mended nets and the cook's sea soup.

drowned-shanty-hour.name: Low Tide
drowned-shanty-hour.blurb: The quiet watch. Slow shanties, lanterns low, and a crew that can't remember its last dry sock.

drowned-shanty-hour.name: The Forenoon Watch
drowned-shanty-hour.blurb: Morning songs to stamp the damp out of the deck. Breakfast is ship's biscuit. It's soft.

end-lounge.name: Last Call
end-lounge.blurb: Last call has been going on for eleven billion years. This is the good part.

end-lounge.name: The Cocktail Hour
end-lounge.blurb: Gilbert mixes, Barnaby introduces heartbreakers, and the universe dims the lights.

end-lounge.name: The Quiet Corner with Greg
end-lounge.blurb: Sundays, two till three. Greg, a shadow, says a few things very softly from the end of the bar. Lean in.

event-horizon-surf.name: Dawn Patrol
event-horizon-surf.blurb: Early sets, an empty beach, and a sunrise that takes the long way round the hole.

event-horizon-surf.name: The Long Sunset
event-horizon-surf.blurb: All four sunsets, back to back, with spring reverb.

event-horizon-surf.name: Night Session
event-horizon-surf.blurb: Slow waves under the glow of the ring. Leashes on.

every-news.name: The Midnight Edition
every-news.blurb: The day's news from every possible day, read slowly, so it sinks in.

every-news.name: Overnight with Kim
every-news.blurb: Kim Harrowgate, still standing in it at three in the morning, holding whatever she's been handed.

every-news.name: Good Morning, Every Timeline
every-news.blurb: Breakfast news, the polite deer on Interstate Zero, and Skip, who has been up since four.

free-frequency.name: The Corkboard Hour
free-frequency.blurb: Static Kate goes through the string on the board, pin by pin. Some of the pins are right.

free-frequency.name: The Midnight Theory
free-frequency.blurb: One theory, all night, until HUSH turns it down. Pirate radio for the small hours.

gristwick-parish.name: The Opening of the Fête
gristwick-parish.blurb: Every morning the Reverend Ashby declares the fête open. Again. Live from the tea tent steps.

gristwick-parish.name: Evensong and Results
gristwick-parish.blurb: The day's results from the judging marquee, the bells, and the band, nearly at the trio section.

gristwick-parish.name: The Night Fête
gristwick-parish.blurb: The fête doesn't close at night. Fairy lights, a lantern on the marrow, and the urn still on.

heat-death-afterparty.name: The Warm-Up
heat-death-afterparty.blurb: The universe is two degrees above absolute zero. Somebody has to warm it up.

heat-death-afterparty.name: The Long Fade
heat-death-afterparty.blurb: The slowest hours. The beat sinks low, the stars go out faster, and nobody leaves.

heat-death-afterparty.name: Morning, Anyway
heat-death-afterparty.blurb: There's no sunrise at the end of the universe. The third guy holds the lamp up high, and we call it dawn.

hold-music.name: The Night Queue
hold-music.blurb: Overnight holding for the dedicated caller. Your call is still important. Slightly less, at this hour.

hold-music.name: Opening Hours
hold-music.blurb: The Department is now open. It was also open before.

hush-after-hours.name: Lights Down
hush-after-hours.blurb: Quiet records for a sleeping ship. Please don't wake the operator.

hush-after-hours.name: The Dawn Watch
hush-after-hours.blurb: HUSH keeps the heading and reads the morning to you, very softly, before you're up.

impossible-sports.name: The Overnight Results
impossible-sports.blurb: Chip's asleep. Doug reads the scores from the sports that are still going. Most of them are still going.

impossible-sports.name: The Warm-Up
impossible-sports.blurb: Chip does his morning stretches, live, with full commentary.

impossible-sports.name: Sunball Tonight
impossible-sports.blurb: Live from Coliseum Zero, where the ball is a small, polite sun.

infinite-song.name: The Morning Verse
infinite-song.blurb: Where the song has got to, for people just waking up. You've missed a lot. It's fine.

infinite-song.name: Chorus Watch
infinite-song.blurb: Listeners report signs of the chorus. It's due. It has been due for some time.

infinite-song.name: The Night Verses
infinite-song.blurb: Ambrose counts the overnight verses under his breath, so as not to lose his place.

island-time.name: Morning, Eventually
island-time.blurb: The breakfast show. It starts when the kettle does, and the kettle is thinking about it.

island-time.name: The Slow Sunset
island-time.blurb: Sooner goes down. Later takes three hours about it. Find a chair facing west and stay in it.

island-time.name: Lying Down Astronomy
island-time.blurb: The dome is open, the hammock is strung, and the telescope is pointed roughly up.

last-lighthouse.name: The Night Forecast
last-lighthouse.blurb: The forecast for the impossible seas, read at the usual hour for anyone who might be out there.

last-lighthouse.name: The Keeper's Log
last-lighthouse.blurb: Entries from the logbook of the Last Lighthouse, read slowly, by lamplight.

lower-hollow.name: Morning Notices
lower-hollow.blurb: Maureen with the noticeboard, the birthdays and the overnight hole report.

lower-hollow.name: The Committee Hour
lower-hollow.blurb: Councillor Dibbs and the week's business. The hole remains.

lower-hollow.name: Rim Watch
lower-hollow.blurb: Overnight with Maureen, a flask and the binoculars, keeping an eye on the hole so you don't have to.

minute-between.name: The Minute
minute-between.blurb: Thirteen minutes from the inside of one. Take your time. There is plenty, all of it the same.

mirror-polka.name: The Actual Polka Hour
mirror-polka.blurb: The one hour of the day when the Polka Hour is technically an hour.

moon-dub.name: Earthrise Session
moon-dub.blurb: Bass for the Earth, coming up over the ridge with a big blue yawn.

neon-2087.name: The Rad Hour
neon-2087.blurb: Velocity counts down the most rad ordinary things of the day.

neon-2087.name: Midnight Drive
neon-2087.blurb: Windows down on the endless grid. It's always midnight here, but this is the real one.

numbers-omega.name: The Late Sequence
numbers-omega.blurb: Numbers for the small hours. Some of them are for you.

orbit-roots.name: First Light Irrigation
orbit-roots.blurb: The misters come on across the whole ring. Crop reports, pump pressure and something gentle for the lettuce.

orbit-roots.name: The Long Table
orbit-roots.blurb: Lunch in the packing shed: whatever is ripe, a crate to sit on, and a little talk about who owns the water.

orbit-roots.name: Deep Roots
orbit-roots.blurb: The greenhouses are dark and the plants are sleeping. The bass goes down into the soil. The roots are awake.

other-horoscopes.name: The Morning Alignment
other-horoscopes.blurb: Your day ahead, in every universe that has days.

other-horoscopes.name: Compatibility Hour
other-horoscopes.blurb: Will a Teapot and a Ladder get along? Callers ask Madame Orrery about partners from other universes.

other-horoscopes.name: Charts for the Night Shift
other-horoscopes.blurb: Readings for whoever is still awake: bakers, nurses, lighthouse keepers and relay operators.

piano-empty-rooms.name: Dust Sheets
piano-empty-rooms.blurb: The furniture is covered for the night. Slow piano for the drawing room, the hall and the chairs.

piano-empty-rooms.name: The Unvisited Hours
piano-empty-rooms.blurb: The quietest hours, in the quietest rooms. Nobody comes. Everything is ready.

piano-empty-rooms.name: First Light in the East Wing
piano-empty-rooms.blurb: Morning sun across bare floorboards, and the piano a little brighter for it.

pixel-afterlife.name: Attract Mode
pixel-afterlife.blurb: After hours, when the cabinets play themselves to remember how.

pixel-afterlife.name: After School Special
pixel-afterlife.blurb: Two-player tunes for the busiest hour in the arcade. Player One, this could be it.

plant-fm.name: First Light
plant-fm.blurb: Fern describes the light as it arrives, a very little at a time.

plant-fm.name: Full Sun
plant-fm.blurb: The brightest hours, celebrated very quietly by everyone on the windowsill.

plant-fm.name: The Dark Hours
plant-fm.blurb: For plants at night: rest, respiration, and growing a little while nobody is looking.

rainfall-fm.name: The Night Tram
rainfall-fm.blurb: Music for the last tram home through Precinct Nine.

rainfall-fm.name: The Kettle Hour
rainfall-fm.blurb: Tea, drizzle, and the morning rainfall totals.

saturday-night-forever.name: The Hustle Hour
saturday-night-forever.blurb: Peak time on the rink. Line dances, hustle lessons and a crowd that last looked at a clock in 1977.

saturday-night-forever.name: Couples Skate
saturday-night-forever.blurb: Lights down, slow songs, and the mirror ball turning just for two. Counter-clockwise, please.

saturday-night-forever.name: Breakfast at the Rink
saturday-night-forever.blurb: The morning show from a night that never ended. Pancakes at the snack bar, under the mirror ball.

small-claims.name: Petty Sessions
small-claims.blurb: The morning list: fences, borrowed hours and the odd cloud. Clerk Odell reads; the Judge takes notes in green ink.

small-claims.name: The Late List
small-claims.blurb: Cases heard after hours, for parties who only exist at night. Noise complaints from the void a speciality.

small-claims.name: Landmark Rulings
small-claims.blurb: Fridays: the Judge revisits the great precedents of the Tribunal. The tide. The last biscuit. The two Tuesdays.

smoke-ring-trio.name: The Supper Club Forecast
smoke-ring-trio.blurb: Dinner, candlelight and a light drizzle of piano. The early set, for people who still have plans.

smoke-ring-trio.name: The 3 AM Set
smoke-ring-trio.blurb: The diners have gone. The trio plays for each other now. You're welcome to listen, quietly.

smoke-ring-trio.name: The Morning After
smoke-ring-trio.blurb: Chairs on the tables, coffee on, and the trio still playing. Nobody has had the heart to tell them.

snail-jams.name: Dew Patrol
snail-jams.blurb: Live traffic on the leaf, and the first sip of the morning.

snail-jams.name: The Slow Hour
snail-jams.blurb: It lasts three hours. We're working on it.

something-listening.name: The Long Listen
something-listening.blurb: The small hours, when the static has the most to say, and says it very quietly.

static-lullabies.name: After the Anthem
static-lullabies.blurb: The broadcast day is over. The static takes the late shift.

static-lullabies.name: The Small Hours
static-lullabies.blurb: For whoever is still awake. Nobody needs anything from you until morning.

substation-null.name: Peak Load
substation-null.blurb: The core at full output. A hundred and thirty-something beats a minute. Nobody talks. Least of all the host.

substation-null.name: Cooldown
substation-null.blurb: Steam, slower kicks, the crowd sitting on the pipes. The coolant is fine.

substation-null.name: The Maintenance Window
substation-null.blurb: Scheduled maintenance. Nothing is maintained. The music continues.

the-harbour.name: Evening Berths
the-harbour.blurb: Ships come in out of the dark, one at a time, and the Harbourmaster talks them in.

the-harbour.name: Lights on the Water
the-harbour.blurb: The small hours at the Harbour. Old ships asleep at the piers, and someone keeping watch for them.

the-harbour.name: The Morning Tide
the-harbour.blurb: Lines off at first light. Ships leave in the morning. They always do.

the-long-dark.name: The Late Matinee
the-long-dark.blurb: The Penumbra Players at their most theatrical: short plays, long pauses, and an organist who has never seen the script.

the-long-dark.name: Lights Out Theatre
the-long-dark.blurb: Small-hours radio theatre, performed with the studio lights off. The Players insist it helps. Mr. Wren insists more.

the-switchboard.name: The Night Exchange
the-switchboard.blurb: The busiest hours on the lines between universes. Everybody rings home after dark.

the-switchboard.name: Early Trunk Calls
the-switchboard.blurb: Long-distance calls at first light, when the lines are clear and the past is cheaper.

tiki-satellite.name: Breakfast in Orbit
tiki-satellite.blurb: The breakfast pill, a sunrise every ninety minutes, and a little vibraphone to start the day of tomorrow.

tiki-satellite.name: The Cocktail Hour of Tomorrow
tiki-satellite.blurb: Zero-gravity cocktails on the Lagoon Deck. Hold your drink with both hands. It will try to leave.

tiki-satellite.name: Moonlight on the Lagoon Deck
tiki-satellite.blurb: The lagoon goes round the wheel, the moon goes round the Earth, and the theremin goes round the room.

tiny-hour.name: Good Morning, Small Ones
tiny-hour.blurb: Breakfast with Auntie Pim: one oat each, a song, and the day's safety tip.

tiny-hour.name: Crafternoon
tiny-hour.blurb: Crafts for very small hands, made from things the big people dropped.

tiny-hour.name: The Very Small Hours
tiny-hour.blurb: For very small listeners who can't sleep. The clock is very loud from down here.

tomorrows-leftovers.name: Breakfast Tomorrow
tomorrows-leftovers.blurb: The most important meal of tomorrow, cooked this morning, so tomorrow you can have a lie-in.

tomorrows-leftovers.name: Pip Cooks Today
tomorrows-leftovers.blurb: Pip cooks with ingredients that already exist. Chef Brodequin watches, appalled.

tomorrows-leftovers.name: The Midnight Larder
tomorrows-leftovers.blurb: Snacks for the small hours, prepared slightly before you get peckish.

traffic-on-the-8s.name: The Morning Crawl
traffic-on-the-8s.blurb: Rush hour, every hour from seven, with Rita at the desk and Buzz over the junction. Nobody is late. Everybody is late.

traffic-on-the-8s.name: The Evening Crawl
traffic-on-the-8s.blurb: The homeward jam, live. The same cars as this morning, facing the other way.

traffic-on-the-8s.name: The Small Hours Jam
traffic-on-the-8s.blurb: Overnight traffic for the lanes that never sleep. Lighter everywhere except the bypass.

transmission-zero.name: First Light
transmission-zero.blurb: At dawn, every dawn since the first one, the First Announcer tries the microphone again.

unsolved-dimensions.name: Morning Roll Call
unsolved-dimensions.blurb: Inspector Gault reviews the overnight incidents. None of them have been solved. She is relieved.

unsolved-dimensions.name: Witness Hour
unsolved-dimensions.blurb: Listeners ring in with information. The Inspector gently talks them out of it.

unsolved-dimensions.name: Cold Cases, Warm Milk
unsolved-dimensions.blurb: The oldest files in the basement, reopened by lamplight and carefully left open.

velvet-collapse.name: The Velvet Hour
velvet-collapse.blurb: Slow funk, low lights and a red giant in the window. Dinner is served with sunglasses.

velvet-collapse.name: The Final Hour
velvet-collapse.blurb: The countdown to four o'clock. The star swells, the bets close, the band plays faster.

velvet-collapse.name: The Collapse
velvet-collapse.blurb: Supernova at four sharp. White light, a short silence, and then, somehow, breakfast.

void-beats.name: The 3 AM Hour
void-beats.blurb: For the ones still awake, and the ones who never sleep.

void-beats.name: The Void Takes Over
void-beats.blurb: DJ Eventually has fallen asleep at the desk. The void is minding the station.

void-beats.name: Study Hall
void-beats.blurb: Beats to finish the thing to. The void is also behind on its reading.

wall-of-fog.name: Soundcheck
wall-of-fog.blurb: The soundcheck began in 1991. Some of it is still going. Join it.

wall-of-fog.name: The Loud Quiet
wall-of-fog.blurb: Very loud, then very, very quiet, then very loud. Ellis has notes. Nobody can read them.

wall-of-fog.name: Fogbound
wall-of-fog.blurb: The small hours, where the reverb is deepest and the lamp keeps watch.

waystation-9.name: The Graveyard Shift
waystation-9.blurb: Long-haul chatter through the dead hours. Big Rosalind on the coffee, Midnight Mongoose on the old river road.

waystation-9.name: The Dawn Run
waystation-9.blurb: Night convoy in, day convoy out, and bacon for everyone.

waystation-9.name: Supper at the Crossroads
waystation-9.blurb: Drivers pull in, swap stories and argue about the sideways road.

whalesong.name: The Night Watch
whalesong.blurb: Captain Hum keeps watch. The whales keep singing. Nobody asks the whales.

whalesong.name: The Dawn Log
whalesong.blurb: There is no dawn between galaxies. Captain Hum keeps one anyway.

wild-multiverse.name: The Dawn Chorus
wild-multiverse.blurb: Something enormous is waking up. Sir Reginald narrates it, very quietly.

wild-multiverse.name: The Night Shoot
wild-multiverse.blurb: Hushed footage from the tall grass after dark. Keep your feet inside the tent.

win-this-planet.name: Win This Planet!
win-this-planet.blurb: The quiz where the questions are about you, and the answers are wrong. Live, before a studio audience of one.

win-this-planet.name: Win This Moon!
win-this-planet.blurb: The daytime spin-off. Smaller prizes, smaller stakes, the same three contestants.

win-this-planet.name: The Graveyard Round
win-this-planet.blurb: Late-night quizzing with the lights down and the buzzer muffled. The planet is asleep. Don't wake it.

yesterday-fm.name: Yesterday Morning
yesterday-fm.blurb: The breakfast show from yesterday. The toast is already eaten. It was lovely.

yesterday-fm.name: The Afternoon Before
yesterday-fm.blurb: Gentle songs and reassuring news from a long, golden afternoon that has already ended well.

yesterday-fm.name: Last Night, Tonight
yesterday-fm.blurb: Gordon goes through last night, hour by hour. Nothing bad happened in any of them.
